title: Collapsible Colander Set of 2 Silicone Kitchen Strainer Set, Perfect for Draining Pasta, Vegetable and fruit for Kitchen and Travel Use (green)
description:
About this item
Superior Quality: Our collapsible colander set is made of TPE+PP material, which is more durable and long-lasting than TPR. It's also BPA-free and reusable, making it a healthier and more eco-friendly choice.
Drain Anything with Ease: With two different sizes (11.6 and 9.8 inches in diameter), this fruit washer strainer set is perfect for all your daily needs, from spaghetti to potatoes, green beans, carrots, and more. You can even use it to rinse your salad leaves, fruits, and fresh vegetables.
Save Space in Your Kitchen - Our ergonomic and space-saving design allows you to fold the silicone strainers down to under 1.5 inches, making them easy to store in a kitchen drawer, cabinet, or drying tray. You can even hang them on a hook! Perfect for small kitchens, camping, RVs, and travel trailers.
Comfortable and Safe: With two handles on either side, this collapsible kitchen sieve is easy to hold and hang. It's also safe to use in boiling water, making it perfect for blanching vegetables like pasta，spinach, broccoli, and green beans.
Upgrade Your Kitchen Game - Our collapsible small colander is made of non-toxic, food-grade silicone that's safe for you and your family. It's easy to clean, whether you prefer handwashing or using the dishwasher. Plus, it's versatile enough to use in or over the sink, or freestanding on a counter or table.
Effortlessly Rinse and Drain - The holes on the bottom of our colander and strainer set are designed to make rinsing and draining a breeze. You won't have to worry about food falling down the drain, and you'll be able to get your food ready in no time.

I purchased these for a Christmas present. Since December 2024, we used them once a week for a pasta meal. They started splitting along the folds in late February.
